answers.q1: pnpm (pinned by packageManager to pnpm@12.9.1; the preinstall script rejects npm and yarn; Node ^20.19.0 || >=22.12.0). Install with: pnpm install. CI also builds first with `pnpm run build`, which the tests need.
answers.q2: pnpm run test. This runs `pnpm test-unit && pnpm test-serve && pnpm test-build`. CI runs `pnpm run build` first and also runs `pnpm run test-serve-bundled`, which `test` does not include. Playwright's browser is needed for the e2e parts: `pnpm playwright install chromium`.
answers.q4: pnpm run build && pnpm run lint && pnpm format && git diff --exit-code && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test-docs. These are the CI lint job's steps in order. Lint runs `eslint --cache . --concurrency auto` and format runs `oxfmt`. The `git diff --exit-code` after `pnpm format` fails if formatting changed any file, so it only works in a git checkout. This directory is not a git repository, so run that step in a real clone. For a formatting-only check, use `pnpm format` and then `git diff --exit-code`.
answers.q5: Generated, ignored by git and not to be edited by hand: any dist/ and dist-ssr/ build outputs, packages/vite/LICENSE (generated at build time, gitignored), playground-temp/, temp/, node_modules/, .pnpm-store/, .eslintcache, docs/.vitepress/cache and docs/.vitepress/.temp. Generated or machine-managed and excluded from formatting: pnpm-lock.yaml, and packages/*/CHANGELOG.md (written by the release tooling). The deliberately odd or vendored test fixtures and assets are playground/external/public/slash@3.0.0.js, playground/ssr-html/public/slash@3.0.0.js, playground/worker/classic-worker.js, the playground/html/*.html invalid and valid files, and everything under **/fixtures/ (ESLint ignores it). Also leave packages/create-vite/template-* alone, since ESLint skips it. The patches/ directory holds dependency patches managed by pnpm.
